paseo.commit_message:
Ask OpenCode before running a Paseo tool (#5801)

OpenCode checks permissions for its own tools and wraps MCP tools in an
ask, but leaves plugin tools to call ctx.ask themselves. The bridge plugin
never did, so an "ask" rule for paseo_* tools never produced a prompt and
the tool ran. The bridge now asks with the tool's catalog name before
dispatching, the same shape OpenCode uses for MCP tools. With no paseo_*
rule OpenCode's default allow applies, so nothing new prompts.

Fixes #5324

ruflo.release_body:
## Security fix: SQL injection in the RuVector GNN SQL builders

`npm install @claude-flow/plugins@3.0.1`. All dist-tags (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha`) point to 3.0.1.

**Who is affected:** code that calls the SQL-generating methods in `integrations/ruvector/gnn.ts` with input it doesn't fully control, then runs the result against PostgreSQL/RuVector. This applies to `@claude-flow/plugins` **3.0.0 and earlier**. Affected methods: `BaseGNNLayer.toSQL()` (every GNN layer), `GraphOperations.kHopNeighborsSQL/shortestPathSQL/pageRankSQL/communityDetectionSQL`, and the `GNNSQLGenerator` static builders. `gnn.js` isn't in the package's `exports` map, so it is only reachable by importing the file by path.

**What was wrong:** node ids, `source`/`target` and the community algorithm name were placed inside single quotes (`WHERE target_id = '${nodeId}'`), so a `'` broke out of the literal. `schema`/`table`/`edgeTable`/`cacheTable` identifiers were wrapped in `"…"`, which doesn't help when the value contains `"`. `nodeColumn` wasn't quoted at all. Numbers (`k`, `damping`, `maxIterations`, `resolution`, `dimension`), layer-config JSON and the prepared-statement `paramPrefix` were interpolated unchecked.

**What changed:** every interpolation now goes through a validator. Identifiers must match `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$` and are quoted. Strings are single-quote-escaped. Numbers must be finite, or integers with a minimum where that makes sense. JSON config is escaped before it is embedded in `jsonb`. Unsafe input throws `TypeError` instead of producing SQL. Legitimate input produces the same SQL as before, except that `nodeColumn` is now quoted. This mirrors the `attention.ts` hardening in #3530.

**What to do:** upgrade to 3.0.1. There are no API changes. If you pass non-plain identifiers (such as `my-table` or `schema.table` strings), the builders now reject them, so map them to plain identifiers first.

## Verification
- A new 25-test injection suite fails 22 tests against the old code and passes against the fix. The full plugins suite (473 passed / 3 skipped) is unchanged, and all 110 CI checks passed on the release PR.
- **Published artifact:** in a fresh `npm install` of 3.0.1, an exploit smoke test passes 8/8. Against 3.0.0 as a control, the same test fails 7/8.
- **Tarball:** the registry tarball is file-for-file identical to `npm pack` of a clean build at `3bcf7e96a`. `dist.integrity` is `sha512-cl86h1eEs5sgCRtenrh4XablDmSQmSEjZRaYOOdwUDMRBz38O1NymS4KJyfVWA49nJ/2A4jIlHi1GtBipxbodw==`.

Fixes #3531 · Fix: #3564 · Release: #3574

This is a standalone `@claude-flow/plugins` release. The `@claude-flow/cli` / `claude-flow` / `ruflo` train is unchanged (latest train release: v3.48.0).

**Full write-up** (affected surface, before/after examples, validation, artifact integrity): https://gist.github.com/ruvnet/1cb9c6894394d5f51cf9e8f52b2ddcc4

🤖 Generated with [RuFlo](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo)

MUL-7821: feat(cli): mark duplicates with issue status/update --duplicate-of (#8979)

* feat(cli): mark duplicates from issue status and issue update (MUL-7821)

Add --duplicate-of to `multica issue status` and `multica issue update`.
It resolves an issue key or UUID and sends duplicate_of_issue_id, which
the server already accepts (MUL-7349). The CLI rejects a status other than
cancelled, and description or attachment changes, before any request or
upload. It fails when the response has no duplicate_of field, so a server
older than v0.5.2 cannot silently drop the mark.

Closes #8974

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

* docs: teach agents to mark duplicates with --duplicate-of (MUL-7821)

Add the command to the agent runtime brief, the multica-platform issues
reference, CLI_AND_DAEMON.md and the CLI docs tables, so agents record the
mark instead of cancelling a duplicate and explaining it in a comment.

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

---------

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

orca.release_body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This patch is built from the September 29 daily build plus fixes picked from main. Pull requests that landed on main after that are not in this build.

## The short version

**Codex terminals:** Settings → Agents has a new **"Run each Codex terminal on its own server"** switch. It's on by default, which keeps agent status and closing tabs working correctly. Turn it off to go back to Codex's shared server and its agents overview. The switch applies to new terminals. A one-time notice explains the change and links to the switch. Codex started from a cmd.exe tab, by its full path, or after "wait for setup" finishes now runs on its own server too. A busy Codex 0.150–0.157 tab no longer shows as idle, and orchestration workers wait out Codex 0.157's startup screen before their brief is typed.

**More agents:** DeepSeek Harness, Freebuff, Qoder, and CodeBuddy are built in: you can launch them from Orca, and their status shows in the sidebar. ZCode CLI conversations appear in session history, and its Coding Plan quota shows in usage.

**Terminal:** A new **Reset Terminal** item in the terminal's right-click menu clears keyboard and mouse modes a crashed program left on. Orca no longer switches those modes off just because it guessed a program had died, so Shift+Enter and Option/Alt keys keep working in Codex and Claude Code after Ctrl+C. SSH terminals now clean up after a crashed program the same way local ones do. Having hundreds of terminals open no longer stops their output, and a failed terminal save no longer claims your disk is full.

**Orca mobile app:** On Windows hosts, phone swipes in a Codex terminal scroll again instead of typing junk into Codex after the desktop app restarts. If you update with terminals open, this takes effect once Orca's background terminal service restarts: after you close all terminals or reboot. The app also tells you when a newer version is available to install, and the keyboard now covers the page like it does on other screens in the app.

**Browser:** If a page in Orca's browser crashes, resizing its viewport no longer crashes Orca. The chosen size is applied when the page loads again. Browser tabs that are moved between groups no longer go blank.

**Native chat (experimental):** Structured chats can run orchestration themselves and receive worker results. Their status, errors, subagents, and stopped turns are now reported more accurately.

**Reliability:** A large diff no longer freezes Orca when many files change at once, and Cmd+J keeps the keyboard in the terminal when a workspace takes a moment to load.

---

## Product experience

### Codex & orchestration

*Codex terminals get a setting to use their own server or Codex's shared one, more Codex launch types run on their own server, and orchestration workers start more reliably.*

* feat(settings): let Codex terminals opt back into Codex's shared server by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23929
* fix(terminal): run Orca's cmd.exe, path-named and setup-gated Codex launches without the shared server by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23933
* fix(runtime): stop a busy Codex 0.150-0.157 pane reading as tui-idle by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23805
* fix(runtime): wait out Codex 0.157's startup screen, and stop at Codex's startup dialogs, before typing a worker brief by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23745
* fix(runtime): reopen the quiet-foreground tui-idle lane for agents with no other rest signal by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23598
* fix(codex): restored Codex panes on a managed account resume instead of failing with SUN_LEN by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23724
* fix(agent-trust): bound the remaining Codex trust writes a launch waits on by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23380
* fix(codex): index a new account home before bridging history into it by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22971
* fix(codex): turning Codex off per agent keeps its hook entry off by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23667
* feat(orchestration): let a structured chat run orchestration as itself by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22568

### Agents & agent integrations

*DeepSeek Harness, Freebuff, Qoder, and CodeBuddy are built in, ZCode history and quota are shown, and agent launches and hooks are more dependable.*

orca.commit_message:
fix(native-chat): the working line shows only what the agent is doing now (#24218)

* fix(native-chat): the working line shows only what the agent is doing now

A chat's live "Working…" line could show an old notice, such as "Claude hit a
temporary problem and is retrying.", long after the agent had moved on and was
running new commands. When the host had no live activity for the turn, the line
fell back to the newest status row in the turn, and any status row qualified:
retry warnings, "Context compacted", "Cancellation requested.", and notification
summaries. Those rows record the past and already appear in the transcript.

The line now reads only the host's live, per-turn activity, which is never saved
and is cleared at turn boundaries. Without it, the line says Thinking or
Working…. Desktop and mobile share the selector, so both change.

* test(codex): guard that a subagent's compaction never becomes the parent's live activity

GenericAgent Desktop 桌面版 / Desktop

三个平台产物来自同一提交，并在公开发布前统一验证。All three platform artifacts come from one commit and are validated before publication.

## 安装方法 / Installation
- Windows x64：下载 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`，解压后双击 `GenericAgent.exe`。卸载时运行 `uninstall.bat`，再删除解压目录。
  Windows x64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`, then launch `GenericAgent.exe`. Run `uninstall.bat` before deleting the extracted directory.
- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。
  Linux x86_64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`, run `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage`, then launch it. Run `uninstall.sh` before deleting the extracted directory.
- macOS Apple silicon (arm64)：打开 `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg`，把 `GenericAgent.app` 拖入 Applications。
  macOS Apple silicon (arm64): open `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg` and drag `GenericAgent.app` to Applications.

## 签名状态 / Signing status
Windows 便携版尚未使用代码签名证书，SmartScreen 可能显示警告；运行前请核对 `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`。
The Windows portable build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt` before running it.

macOS 应用仅使用 ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Apple Developer ID，也未 notarize。首次打开可能需要右键选择“打开”或在“隐私与安全性”中允许。
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed only. It is neither Developer ID signed nor notarized; first launch may require Open from the context menu or approval in Privacy & Security.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.7.5

Released: 2026-09-30

## English

### OMP/Pi control-input reliability

- Opening `/model` or another control-only native selector no longer terminates an active OMP or Pi ask as superseded. The shared extension still binds recognized CCB dispatches immediately, but unmatched input alone is no longer treated as a replacement provider turn.
- A genuinely different prompt supersedes the active request only when it reaches the provider's `before_agent_start` lifecycle boundary. Explicit native `session_switch` events and later recognized CCB dispatches retain their existing replacement behavior and diagnostics.
- The fix is lifecycle-based rather than a `/model` command whitelist, so future control-only selectors do not need command-name exceptions.

### Verification and upgrade

- 302 focused Pi/OMP, runtime-launch, FIFO, and dispatcher regressions passed; two existing opt-in smoke tests were skipped. The generated Pi extension was executed with Bun to verify control input, real replacement turns, and native session switches, and the generated OMP extension was checked against the same boundary.
- In a disposable v8.7.5 source project, real OMP 18.3.5 switched from `paratera2/grok-4.6` to `bingxing/AWS-GPT-5.6-Sol` while job `job_727bce7356c0` was running a tool. The same attempt remained running, then completed once with exact reply `CCB_RELEASE_875_MODEL_SWITCH_OK`; no `request_superseded` event was emitted.
- Update CCB, then restart affected OMP/Pi panes or reopen the project when current work can safely be interrupted. Existing panes keep their already-loaded extension until restart. No project, conversation, or configuration migration is required.
- Android metadata and release assets remain synchronized with the coordinated release pipeline. This release adds no mobile UI behavior.

### Known limitations

- Pi uses the same repaired generated extension and passed Bun lifecycle replay plus pane-adapter regressions, but an authenticated real Pi TUI `/model` switch was not run separately for this release.
- The fix prevents false supersession; it does not make the entire native model-picker interaction atomic or recover unsaved drafts and in-flight provider operations after a process crash.

## 中文

### OMP/Pi 控制输入稳定性

- 打开 `/model` 或其他仅用于原生界面控制的选择器时，不再把正在执行的 OMP/Pi ask 误判为已被替换。共享扩展仍会立即绑定合法的 CCB 投递，但不会仅凭一条未匹配的输入事件终止当前任务。
- 只有不同的新提示真正到达 provider 的 `before_agent_start` 生命周期边界时，才会 supersede 当前请求。明确的原生 `session_switch` 事件和后续合法 CCB 投递仍保留原有替换语义及诊断信息。
- 修复依据生命周期边界，而不是维护 `/model` 命令白名单，因此未来新增的纯控制选择器无需逐个添加命令名称例外。

### 验证与升级

- 302 项 Pi/OMP、运行时启动、FIFO 和 dispatcher 聚焦回归通过；2 项原有的显式启用 smoke 测试跳过。测试使用 Bun 执行生成的 Pi 扩展，覆盖控制输入、真实替换回合和原生会话切换，并确认生成的 OMP 扩展采用相同边界。
- 在一次性 v8.7.5 源码项目中，真实 OMP 18.3.5 在任务 `job_727bce7356c0` 执行工具期间，从 `paratera2/grok-4.6` 切换到 `bingxing/AWS-GPT-5.6-Sol`。同一 attempt 在切换后保持 running，随后仅完成一次并精确返回 `CCB_RELEASE_875_MODEL_SWITCH_OK`，没有产生 `request_superseded` 事件。
- 更新 CCB 后，请在当前工作可以安全中断时重启受影响的 OMP/Pi pane，或重新打开项目。已有 pane 会继续使用启动时加载的旧扩展，直至重启。无需迁移项目、对话或配置。
- Android 元数据及发布产物继续使用现有统一发布流程；本版本没有新增手机端界面功能。

### 已知限制

- Pi 使用同一份已修复的生成扩展，并通过 Bun 生命周期回放及 pane adapter 回归，但本版本没有单独执行真实、已登录的 Pi TUI `/model` 切换。
- 本修复解决错误 supersede，不保证整个原生模型选择过程具备事务原子性，也不恢复进程崩溃前未提交的草稿或正在执行的 provider 操作。

> ## Documentation Index

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
